_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Aylmer Maude (1858-1938) and Louise Maude (1855-1939), Tolstoy's authorised translators. PUBLIC-DOMAIN EDITIONS ONLY: each title must be a printing before 1931 (US). UK copyright in their translations ran to end-1999/2009 and is now expired. Year per title is taken from the fetched file where it states one (fetch report + notes); where the file states no year, the title rests on Project Gutenberg's US clearance (pre-1931 publication) and says so. Added 2026-10-02 at the coordinator's relay; Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.
